sentences.text: Shri Abhay Saraswat, learned counsel for the appellant.
Shri Hemant Sharma, learned Government Advocate for the  respondent / State.

Heard on I.A. No.17443/2025, which is a repeat (seventh) application under Section 430(1) of the Bhartiya Nagarik Suraksha Sanhita, 2023 for suspension of jail sentence and grant of bail filed on behalf of appellant - Pappu @ Pappu Singh Chouhan S/o Jiwan Lal Singh Chouhan.

The present appellant has been convicted for commission of offences punishable under Sections 420, 467, 468 & 471 of the Indian Penal Code and sentenced to undergo 05 years' rigorous imprisonment along with fine of Rs.5,000/- and 07 years' rigorous imprisonment along with fine of Rs.5,000/- , 07 years' rigorous imprisonment along with fine of Rs.5,000/-, 07 years' rigorous imprisonment along with fine of Rs.5,000/- respectively with default stipulations.
Learned counsel for the appellant submits that the appellant has undergone more than three years of jail incarceration.
The main accused Bagdiram @ Prabhulal has been given the benefit of suspension of sentence vide order dated 09.08.2024 passed in Criminal Appeal No.12385 of 2022.
Even otherwise, this is an appeal of 2023 and final hearing of the same is not possible in near future.
On such premises, a prayer has been made that the 2 CRA-159-2023 jail sentence of the present appellant be also suspended.
Learned Government Advocate for the respondent / State opposed the application.

Considering the totality of the facts and circumstances of the case so also the fact the co-accused - Bagdiram @ Prabhulal has been given the benefit of suspension of jail sentence, I deem it appropriate to suspend the remaining jail sentence of the present appellant.
Hence, maintaining the principle of parity, I.A. No.17443/2025 stands allowed.

The execution of remaining jail sentence of the present appellant shall remain suspended during the pendency of the appeal and he be released on bail upon furnishing personal bond in the sum of Rs.50,000/- (Rupees Fifty Thousand Only) with one solvent surety of the like amount to the satisfaction of the trial Court and on depositing the fine amount (if not already deposited) with a further direction to appear before the Registry of this Court on 20.04.2026 and all subsequent dates Pappu @ Pappu Singh Chouhan vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 2 January, 2026 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/35364832/
